social_circle.name: Gloria Cooper

background.how_they_met: She is Kweku's mother and raised him in Blountstown with his father and siblings.
background.why_close: They are close through family obligation, church tradition, practical caregiving, and living nearby. Kweku checks on her regularly and helps with groceries, appointments, medicine pickup, and small house tasks.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts short practical messages, often with full sentences, reminders, prayerful language, and occasional phone calls when something needs explaining.

shared_activities: talking about church people and relatives
recent_text_topics: Reminders about diabetes and blood pressure appointments, pharmacy pickups, and whether she needs groceries.
Plans for Kweku to come by Sunday or Monday after work or church.
Family updates, church homecomings, prayer requests, and checking whether rising prices are stretching anyone too thin.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05: "My mother lives nearby, and I check on her a couple times a week" and "in person on Sunday or Monday." Q35: "She has diabetes and blood pressure issues" and Kweku helps with rides or medicine pickup. Q47: he goes with her to her Missionary Baptist church some Sundays.

background.how_they_met: She is Kweku's older sister; they grew up together in the same Blountstown household.
background.why_close: They are not in each other's business daily, but they show up for each other when family needs arise. She coordinates more of their mother's health scheduling, and Kweku trusts her enough to talk about stress.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts in complete but quick sentences, often task-focused. She sends appointment times, kid updates, and direct advice, with little patience for vague plans.

shared_activities: private conversations about stress and fairness
recent_text_topics: Coordinating their mother's appointments, bills, and pharmacy needs.
Kweku visiting Marianna for a birthday or school event and bringing practical gifts for the kids.
Talking about prices, family stress, and how her kids will experience driving, policing, and growing up in the area.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05: Kweku has "an older sister in Marianna with two kids" and they show up if something happens. Q35: his sister does more hands-on scheduling for their mother's health. Q45: he would probably talk first to his sister or Marcus if stress got worse. Q30: his sister is more direct about race and policing because she has kids.

shared_activities: private conversations about stress or race

Kweku's holiday conflict at work and using fishing to cool down before addressing his manager.
Jaguars talk, local gossip, and keeping political conversations off Facebook.
